item.name: Wait
item.purpose: Adds a pause before the next node runs.
item.defaultOrRange: Default 1 second.
item.usedFor: Line up hitboxes, visuals, sounds, cancels, branch checks, and variant timing.
item.notes: The source uses Wait as the basic timing spacer for Skill Builder sequences.

item.name: Skill
item.purpose: Runs one of the game's existing skills inside the custom move.
item.defaultOrRange: Speed, Cancel Last, Enable Variants, Hold For, and Start. Enable Variants is on by default.
item.usedFor: Reuse normal character skills, trigger skill variants, or start a move at a later point.
item.notes: Speed 0 stops the skill from performing normally, though some effects may still appear.

item.name: Special
item.purpose: Runs one of the game's existing special moves.
item.defaultOrRange: Speed, Cancel Last, and Variants. Specials do not have Hold For.
item.usedFor: Build custom specials or combine special behavior with timeline cancels.
item.notes: The current issues section warns that some specials or related moves can break custom moves.

item.name: Animation
item.purpose: Plays a selected skill, special, melee, awakening, or emote animation.
item.defaultOrRange: Slider, Speed, Loop, Fade In, Fade Out, and Last Hit. Speed defaults to 1.
item.usedFor: Give the custom move a pose, motion, target animation, loop, or smoother transition.
item.notes: Loop lasts until another Animation node is reached; without a later node, the source says it will not loop.

item.name: Sound
item.purpose: Plays a custom audio ID when the timeline reaches the node.
item.valueType: Roblox audio ID plus playback settings
item.defaultOrRange: Volume defaults to 0.5, Speed defaults to 1, Start defaults to 0, End defaults to 500.
item.usedFor: Add feedback, cancel matching sounds, make audio global, or attach a sound to a projectile tag.
item.notes: The source points builders to the Roblox Creator Store for working audio IDs.

item.name: Velocity
item.purpose: Controls user or target movement during the custom move.
item.valueType: XYZ force, time, and movement toggles
item.defaultOrRange: Force defaults to 0 on X, Y, and Z. Time is measured in seconds.
item.usedFor: Dash, launch, pull, float, track facing direction, or apply ragdoll movement.
item.notes: The current issues section says Velocity over about 1000 can make the player jitter.

item.name: Connect
item.purpose: Sends an activation signal to matching Connect Blocks.
item.defaultOrRange: Uses a Signal value, duration, and proximity range.
item.usedFor: Trigger Build Mode contraptions from a custom move.
item.notes: The source compares Signal to the ID system used by Logic Blocks.

item.name: Hitbox
item.purpose: Creates an area that affects targets when the keyframe is reached.
item.valueType: Position, size, damage, stun, attack type, blocking, and branch settings
item.defaultOrRange: Position defaults to 0,0,4; Size defaults to 6 studs.
item.usedFor: Deal damage, stun, break debris, choose counterability, trigger branches, or attach to a projectile.
item.notes: Any Debree value over 0 can harm domains according to the source.

item.name: Branch
item.purpose: Triggers a named branch or random branch path.
item.valueType: Branch name or comma-separated random branch list
item.defaultOrRange: Random branch lists use comma-separated names without spaces, such as A,B,C.
item.usedFor: Build move variants, hit-cancel paths, air/ground versions, or random outcomes.
item.notes: Properties are global across branches and cannot be changed per branch as of the source revision.

item.name: Visual
item.purpose: Creates a custom visual effect for a chosen amount of time.
item.valueType: Effect picker, color, opacity, position, rotation, size, time, tags, and easing
item.defaultOrRange: Color and Alt Color default to 255,255,255; Opacity uses 0 as visible and 1 as invisible; Size defaults to 1.
item.usedFor: Add VFX, camera effects, mesh/billboard effects, projectile-attached visuals, or cancel tagged visuals.
item.notes: Some effects need specific settings, such as Dismantle and Mass Hit needing Position and Alt Position.

item.name: Grab
item.purpose: Sticks one of a target's body parts to the user's body after damage is dealt.
item.valueType: Limb, target limb, position, rotation, time, and Last Hit
item.defaultOrRange: Time defaults to 1. Last Hit defaults to -1.
item.usedFor: Hold a target in place for follow-up animation, damage, or branch timing.
item.notes: The current issues section says Grab can teleport the user if the ability ends before stun registers; adding a Wait for the grab duration can fix that case.

item.name: Projectile
item.purpose: Creates a moving hitbox that travels from one place to another.
item.valueType: Projectile tag, position, size, velocity, gravity, time, and hit behavior
item.defaultOrRange: Uses Projectile Tag to connect visuals, sounds, and hitboxes to the same projectile.
item.usedFor: Make ranged attacks, moving collision, or projectile-attached effects.
item.notes: The approved data shape keeps projectile-specific rows together with tags so builders can see what links to it.

item.name: Counter
item.purpose: Creates a counter check without normal animations or damage.
item.valueType: Attack type, time, stun, and enemy cancel settings
item.defaultOrRange: Attack types include Melee, Bullet, Explosion, Swarm, and Domain.
item.usedFor: React to incoming attacks and optionally stun or interrupt the attacker.
item.notes: Multiple attack types can be countered when configured.

item.name: Tag
item.purpose: Adds or checks a temporary tag on the user.
item.defaultOrRange: Tags last for a chosen period of time.
item.usedFor: Create temporary variables for variants, cooldown bypasses, branch checks, or chained move logic.
item.notes: The source describes tags as variables that latch onto a player.

item.name: State
item.purpose: Applies a state to the user.
item.valueType: State picker and duration or multiplier settings
item.defaultOrRange: States include Stun, IFrame, NoM1, NoSprint, NoJump, NoDash, DisableChase, Block, DirectionLock, SpeedMultiplier, JumpMultiplier, and more.
item.usedFor: Control movement, blocking, invulnerability, chase, speed, jump, or stun behavior during a custom move.
item.notes: Use short state rows on cards; the full state list is too long for public card prose.

item.name: Add Awakening
item.purpose: Adds awakening resource to the user.
item.defaultOrRange: Uses a chosen amount.
item.usedFor: Reward or drain move flow around awakening-based custom behavior.
item.notes: Keep this separate from Properties; it changes resource during the timeline.

item.name: Add Health
item.purpose: Adds or removes health when the timeline reaches the node.
item.defaultOrRange: Can target the user or recent target. Single Target controls target scope.
item.usedFor: Make healing, recoil, self-damage, or target health effects.
item.notes: Unlike Hitbox self-damage, the source distinguishes health effects from lethal hitbox damage behavior.

item.name: Add Evasive
item.purpose: Adds evasive resource or behavior to the custom move flow.
item.defaultOrRange: Uses a chosen amount.
item.usedFor: Tie a custom move to evasive resource behavior.
item.notes: Use this as a timeline resource row, not a global move property.

item.name: Hit Cancel
item.purpose: Cancels the remaining custom move when prior stun or damage has happened in its checked window.
item.defaultOrRange: Time dictates the checked frame window.
item.usedFor: Stop a move after hit confirmation, build blockable starts, or route hit and miss branches.
item.notes: The current issues section says Hit Cancel can register stun from outside the custom move if Time goes beyond startup.

item.name: Loop
item.purpose: Loops a section of timeline behavior.
item.defaultOrRange: Uses Fade In, Fade Out, and Last Hit settings in the source row.
item.usedFor: Repeat a move segment or keep a custom effect running until a later point.
item.notes: Use with care because repeated timeline behavior can make debugging harder.

item.name: In Air
item.purpose: Gates a custom ability or branch by grounded versus airborne state.
item.defaultOrRange: True side: ground-only. False side: airborne-only.
item.usedFor: Split ground and air variants.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Is Jumping
item.purpose: Gates use by whether the jump input is being held.
item.defaultOrRange: True side: not holding jump. False side: holding jump.
item.usedFor: Make hold-jump alternate starts.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Has Target
item.purpose: Gates use by whether a valid target is in sight through the cursor.
item.defaultOrRange: True side: no valid target in sight. False side: valid target in sight.
item.usedFor: Separate lock-on or no-target behavior.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Is Awakened
item.purpose: Gates use by base state versus awakening state.
item.defaultOrRange: True side: base state. False side: awakening state.
item.usedFor: Make base-only or awakening-only custom moves.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Has Awk Bar
item.purpose: Checks the user's awakening percentage against a chosen amount.
item.defaultOrRange: Default 5%. True side: less than or equal. False side: greater than or equal.
item.usedFor: Lock moves behind awakening meter checks.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Durability
item.purpose: Gives the custom ability or branch a use limit.
item.defaultOrRange: Default 1. The source says the false side cannot be toggled.
item.usedFor: Erase or expire custom moves after limited uses.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Is In Domain
item.purpose: Gates use by whether the user is inside a domain.
item.defaultOrRange: True side: outside a domain. False side: inside a domain.
item.usedFor: Make domain-only or outside-domain variants.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Has Health
item.purpose: Checks the user's health against a chosen amount.
item.defaultOrRange: True side: less than or equal. False side: greater than or equal.
item.usedFor: Trigger low-health or high-health behavior.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Is Holding
item.purpose: Gates use by whether the player is holding the keybind.
item.defaultOrRange: True side: not holding the keybind. False side: holding the keybind.
item.usedFor: Build hold-input custom behavior.
item.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.

item.name: Damage Multiplier
item.purpose: Multiplies the custom ability's overall damage.
item.defaultOrRange: Chosen value.
item.usedFor: Tune total damage after the timeline is built.
item.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.

item.name: Knockback Multiplier
item.purpose: Multiplies the custom ability's overall knockback.
item.defaultOrRange: Chosen value.
item.usedFor: Tune launch or push strength across the move.
item.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.

item.name: Invincible
item.purpose: Grants total i-frames while the ability runs.
item.defaultOrRange: On or off.

item.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.

item.purpose: Lets the custom move replace an already occupied move slot.
item.defaultOrRange: On or off.
